segments.en: One should immerse oneself every single day. Through this one becomes sanctified and emerges from all the spiritual impurity of one's sins, and draws close to Hashem Yisborach in truth — and is saved from all troubles, both physical and spiritual — in the aspect of: "The mikveh of Yisroel is Hashem, Who saves in time of trouble."
